"Only watched, did I? That clamp did not point itself out. You can at least get the story straight while I stand here."
Keith keeps the toolbox tucked under his arm.

"See, some of us use our eyes. Fine, the tools are here; do not make me the permanent box stand."
Keith holds the toolbox open beside him.

"Show him the route first, then. I am not hauling him out when you two have sent him into something stupid."
Keith leaves the gateway open and gestures toward Olin.

"Oh, come on. Yesterday it was training, today it is running away? Stay here a minute; you have not even heard the route."
Keith shifts into the open gateway.
